audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose was generic assassin filler and called LeBlanc 'him' in a dozen fields.
audit.why: LeBlanc is female per champ-gender.js. The real difficulty is that Ethereal Chains reaches 925 — further than she needs to dash — and Distortion gives her a free exit from any trade she starts.
audit.corrected: Hard at 8/10 on the page, but a 50.16% win rate over 2,251 games: the lane is even if you respect 925 and punish the Distortion return.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[N].side read 'LeBlanc' while content win[] read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei and matched the packet levelChart.
audit.why: Pre-6 LeBlanc has Sigil of Malice at 700 and a 15-second Distortion; Hwei out-ranges her and she cannot trade repeatedly. Level 6 with Mimic doubling Ethereal Chains is the genuine coin flip. The content layer and the packet agree; the full layer was stale.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side to Hwei, phases[3..4].side to Skill, phases[5..6].side to Hwei, with every why rewritten to the row's verdict and ratings 0-2 eased to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two decisive interactions were never stated, and content used a fabricated Hwei name plus a nonexistent stun ('Severalty (Q) wall', 'longer-range E stun').
audit.why: Ethereal Chains only roots if the shackle survives 1.5 seconds — walking out of 925 denies the root entirely. Distortion commits her to a 600-unit dash with a 4-second return window, so the return spot is the punishable one. Hwei's E line is Grim Visage (fear), Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw — no stun.
audit.corrected: Walk the chain off inside 1.5s; paint the Distortion return spot; Mimic (45/35/25) doubling Ethereal Chains is the version that kills you.

audit.why: Distortion 15/13.75/12.5/11.25/10, Sigil of Malice flat 6s at 700, Mimic 45/35/25, Ethereal Chains 14 down to 11.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mirror Image was never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot's text: below 40% health she goes invisible for 1 second and leaves a damageless clone for up to 8 seconds.
audit.corrected: Not written into a field this pass — I could not source whether Hwei's signature mark or Spiraling Despair follows the real LeBlanc or the clone, and I will not guess. Recorded in notes.

edits.before: LeBlanc wins by landing Distortion, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.

edits.before: Standing mid-cast-animation inside his engage range with the fear already spent — every assassin and fighter in the pool is waiting for exactly that frame.
